newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch December consumer confidence falls slightly.
newsitem.headline: Dutch December consumer confidence falls slightly.

text.p: The Dutch consumer confidence index fell to one in December from two in November, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said.
DUTCH CONSUMER CONFIDENCE Dec 96 Nov 96 Dec 95
Note - The index can vary between -100 and +100 points with zero as the neutral midpoint. A negative index value indicates a majority of the consumers polled by the CBS are pessimistic.
The total index is made up of two subindices which reflect consumers' feelings about the general economic climate and about their personal finances and spending plans:
NOTES - The CBS said it was normal for the sub-index for personal finances and spending plans to decline gradually from a peak in the summer to a low in the dark winter months.
In most years the decline was about nine or 10 index points and this year's decline of 11 points was more or less in line with the longer term average, it added.
